# China Daily
> China Daily is China’s leading English-language news portal, covering China, world affairs, business, culture, opinion, sports, and multimedia.

China Daily connects China and the world through daily reporting, explainers, interviews, photo features, videos, and special coverage. The site includes major editorial channels, regional reporting, business and policy news, culture and lifestyle coverage, and multimedia storytelling for international readers.

## Top News
- [Homepage](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/): Main entry for top stories, featured reports, and channel navigation.
- [China](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china): National news, policy updates, society, diplomacy, and major domestic developments.
- [World](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world): International news, geopolitics, regional developments, and global affairs coverage.
- [Business](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business): Business, trade, markets, industry, technology, and macroeconomic reporting.
- [Opinion](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/opinion): Editorials, commentaries, columns, and analysis on current affairs.
- [China Daily PDF](https://epaper.chinadaily.com.cn/): Digital newspaper edition with page-by-page access to print content.

## China Coverage
- [China News](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china): Broad coverage of politics, society, education, health, and regional developments.
- [Policy Updates](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/policy): Reporting on government policy, regulation, and official initiatives.
- [Society](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/society): Stories on communities, public services, social trends, and daily life.
- [Regional News](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/regional): Local reporting from provinces, municipalities, and development zones.
- [Hong Kong](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/hongkong): News and analysis focused on Hong Kong affairs.
- [Macau](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/macau): Coverage of Macau policy, economy, tourism, and society.

## World & Diplomacy
- [World News](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world): Global headlines, diplomacy, conflicts, and international developments.
- [Asia](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/asia): Regional reporting on Asian politics, economies, and societies.
- [Americas](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/americas): News from North and South America with China-related context.
- [Europe](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/europe): European politics, economy, diplomacy, and regional developments.
- [Africa](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/africa): Reporting on African countries, partnerships, and development issues.
- [Middle East](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/world/middleeast): Coverage of Middle East affairs, diplomacy, and security.
- [China-US](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/chinaus): News and analysis on China-US relations and exchanges.

## Business & Economy
- [Business](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business): Main business channel for markets, trade, and corporate developments.
- [Economy](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business/economy): Macroeconomy, policy, consumption, and growth-related reporting.
- [Companies](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business/companies): Corporate news, earnings, strategy, and industry developments.
- [Tech](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business/tech): Technology, innovation, digital economy, and startup coverage.
- [Motoring](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business/motoring): Automotive industry news, EVs, production, and market trends.
- [Belt and Road](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business/beltandroad): Coverage of Belt and Road projects, trade, and cooperation.
- [China Economy](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/business/chinaeconomy): Reporting on domestic economic trends and structural changes.

## Opinion & Analysis
- [Opinion](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/opinion): Central hub for editorials, columns, and expert commentary.
- [Editorials](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/opinion/editorial): Official editorials on major domestic and international issues.
- [Columnists](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/opinion/columnists): Commentary from regular contributors and guest writers.
- [Cartoons](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/opinion/cartoon): Editorial cartoons on politics, society, and current events.
- [Op-Ed Contributors](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/opinion/oped): Guest opinion pieces and analytical essays.
- [Global View](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/opinion/globalview): International perspectives on world affairs and China’s role.

## Culture, Lifestyle & Travel
- [Culture](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/culture): Arts, heritage, books, film, exhibitions, and cultural trends.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/life): Food, fashion, wellness, travel, and modern living features.
- [Travel](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/life/travel): Destinations, tourism trends, itineraries, and travel features.
- [Food](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/life/food): Dining, cuisine, chefs, and culinary culture stories.
- [Fashion](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/life/fashion): Fashion industry news, style trends, and designer features.
- [Books](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/culture/books): Book news, reviews, publishing, and literary coverage.
- [Art](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/culture/art): Visual arts, museums, exhibitions, and artist profiles.

## Sports & Entertainment
- [Sports](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports): Coverage of major sporting events, leagues, and athletes.
- [Olympics](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/olympics): Olympic news, preparations, results, and athlete stories.
- [Football](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/football): Domestic and international football reporting and analysis.
- [Basketball](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/basketball): Basketball news, leagues, players, and tournament coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/sports/tennis): Tournament updates, player profiles, and match reporting.
- [Entertainment](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/entertainment): Film, television, music, celebrities, and pop culture coverage.
- [Celebrities](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/entertainment/celebrities): Profiles, interviews, and celebrity news.

## Multimedia
- [Photo](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/photo): Photo galleries, visual features, and image-driven storytelling.
- [Video](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/video): Video reports, interviews, explainers, and feature packages.
- [China Daily Audio](https://language.chinadaily.com.cn/audio): Audio content and listening materials for English learners.
- [Special Coverage](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/special_coverage): Thematic packages on major events and long-running topics.
- [Infographics](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/china/infographics): Visual explainers on policy, society, and current affairs.
- [Web Specials](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/a/special): Curated special reports and event-focused coverage.

## Learning English
- [Language Tips](https://language.chinadaily.com.cn/): English-learning portal with news-based study materials and resources.
- [News English](https://language.chinadaily.com.cn/news_bilingual): Bilingual news content for reading and vocabulary practice.
- [Audio News](https://language.chinadaily.com.cn/audio): Listening practice with spoken news and feature content.
- [Translation Tips](https://language.chinadaily.com.cn/trans_collect): Translation and language learning reference materials.
- [Campus](https://language.chinadaily.com.cn/campus): Student-focused English learning and campus-related content.
- [Study Abroad](https://language.chinadaily.com.cn/studyabroad): Information and stories related to overseas study and education.

## Regional & Local
- [Regional](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/regional): Hub for local development, investment, and city-level reporting.
- [Beijing](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/regional/beijing): News and features from the capital region.
- [Shanghai](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/regional/shanghai): Reporting on Shanghai economy, culture, and urban development.
- [Guangdong](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/regional/guangdong): Coverage of Guangdong’s industry, trade, and local affairs.
- [Yangtze River Delta](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/regional/ydl): Regional integration, economy, and innovation reporting.
- [Greater Bay Area](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/regional/greaterbayarea): News on development and cooperation in the Greater Bay Area.

## Newspaper & Archives
- [China Daily E-paper](https://epaper.chinadaily.com.cn/): Digital replica of the print newspaper with current and archived issues.
- [China Daily Europe](https://europe.chinadaily.com.cn/): Europe-focused edition with regional and China-related reporting.
- [China Daily Asia](https://asia.chinadaily.com.cn/): Asia edition featuring regional news and analysis.
- [China Daily USA](https://usa.chinadaily.com.cn/): US edition with China-US coverage and international reporting.
- [China Daily App](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/static_e/2016app/index.html): Information about the mobile app for accessing China Daily content.
- [Site Map](https://www.chinadaily.com.cn/static_e/2016sitemap.html): Structured navigation to major channels and site sections.
